subtitulo: Five questions about red dates, long weekends and days off
introPt: A traveller checks four doors and stops guessing from the calendar.
cenario: A holiday week, and four different answers on the same street.

dialogo.es: 明日は祝日ですけど、うちは普通に営業してますよ。
dialogo.pt: Tomorrow's a holiday, but we're open as usual.
dialogo.tts: 明日は祝日ですけど、うちは普通に営業してますよ。

dialogo.es: うちは連休で、月曜までお休みなんです。
dialogo.pt: We're on the long weekend, so we're closed until Monday.
dialogo.tts: うちは連休で、月曜までお休みなんです。

dialogo.es: 元日は、どこも閉まってますよ。パン屋さんもね。
dialogo.pt: On New Year's Day, everything's closed. Even the bakery.
dialogo.tts: 元日は、どこも閉まってますよ。パン屋さんもね。

dialogo.es: うちは水曜が定休日なんですよ。
dialogo.pt: Our regular day off is Wednesday.
dialogo.tts: うちは水曜が定休日なんですよ。

perguntas.pergunta: Japanese law lists sixteen national holidays. How many oblige a shop to close?
opcoes: None — a holiday marks the date, it does not force closure
perguntas.explica: The 国民の祝日に関する法律 lists sixteen; none obliges a shop to close. Konbini and stations run straight through.

perguntas.pergunta: The shop next door is open on the same national holiday. What is happening?
opcoes: The holiday obliges nobody to close, so each shop decides
Their holiday is a different date
perguntas.explica: Each door decides separately, which is why you ask the door, not the calendar.

perguntas.pergunta: The Happy Monday system (ハッピーマンデー制度) means:
opcoes: A holiday moved to any weekday
Several holidays fixed to a Monday, so a long weekend forms — taking it is each shop's own call
perguntas.explica: Introduced in 2000 to create three-day weekends; whether a shop takes the whole renkyuu is its own decision.

perguntas.pergunta: Which windows genuinely slow the whole country?
opcoes: Year-end/New Year (年末年始) and Obon (お盆) in mid-August
perguntas.explica: Banks close by regulation 31 Dec to 3 Jan; Obon empties the big cities. These are the two to plan around.

perguntas.pergunta: A door sign reads «定休日 水曜». What does it tell you?
opcoes: The whole street is shut on Wednesdays
This one shop's fixed weekly day off is Wednesday; the next closes on a different day
The street is being closed for works
perguntas.explica: Teikyuubi is one shop's own weekly rest, drawn on the door — one shop, one weekday, its own choice.
